reason: The rover is meant to make one last invitation, and the banner looks like the surface for it.
expectation: The rover will draw a welcome on the banner.

effect: The banner is decorated and ready to be used at the fair.
reaction: The rover's looping border and Kit's whale are a charming welcome.
reason: The finished banner seems ready to be displayed at the fair.
expectation: The welcome banner will be displayed as part of the fair.

effect: The banner is hung safely across the cradle, leaving the two controls ready.
reaction: Keeping it clear of the tether lines makes practical sense.
reason: The lift-control key should start the flying part of the fair.
expectation: The whale will rise on its garden tethers.

alternatives.reason: The dragon and stars could be switched on before takeoff instead.

effect: The lift-control key has no available operation yet, so I’ll try starting the attractions first.
reaction: The failed attempt suggests there is an order to opening the fair.
reason: The accessory switch may need to start the dragon and stars before the whale can rise.
expectation: The dragon and star theatre will switch on.

effect: The attractions are running, so the lift control may now be available.
reaction: The dragon waving while the stars move makes the fair feel ready for flight.
reason: The lift key failed before the attractions were switched on; the result now points to trying the flight.
expectation: The whale will rise on its garden tethers.

effect: The lift key worked after the attractions were switched on, and the tethered whale rose to complete the fair.
reaction: Seeing Jo’s drawing finally take flight was a satisfying conclusion.

mostWorthwhile.text: Starting the attractions and then lifting the whale brought the dragon, stars and flying fair together for the finale.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the lift key before the attractions was a brief dead end; the result did not explain why it was unavailable.

surprise.text: I expected the whale to lift before the attractions started, but the controls had to be used in the opposite order.

arbitrary.text: Starting the accessories before lift felt somewhat arbitrary: the failed attempt gave no explanation for that ordering.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue if another chapter offered a new mechanism to explore, though this finale feels like a natural stopping point.
